The ADJ Jolt Bar FX is a professional linear LED fixture that delivers lighting designers huge output as well as the creative potential of brilliant bright white strobe/blinder LEDs combined with multi-colored chase effects in one versatile unit. Ideal for concert productions, festival stages and rental houses, as well as for permanent installation in large nightclubs, the Jolt Bar FX is a flexible fixture that can be used to create a wide variety of effects.
